evidence_proposition: System-only J-PCMCI+ on the retained two-environment CSVs reproduces the frozen edge set recorded from a historical black-box Tigramite 5.2.9.7 run.
limitations: The frozen edge set is a historical external output whose harness was not retained; no generator can be rerun here and independence of the original author is unknown. One fixed realization, no space dummies or context, no error rate or calibration.
